subject: S3-backed dense-index prefetch & mutual action plan

From: Ethan Browne <ethan@pinecone.io>

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.example
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: S3-backed dense index prefetch—proof-of-concept proposal

Hi Vanessa / Karthik,

Thanks for the time earlier. As discussed, Pinecone can support a hybrid vector store where dense index partitions are prefetched from S3 into a hot pod cache when a query footprint indicates imminent reuse. This lets NimbusData keep large cold pools on S3 while maintaining tail latency for interactive sessions.

I've attached a short architecture sketch and a one-page summary of tradeoffs. High level items we recommend for the POC:
- Prefetch window based on session affinity (30s–5m)
- Async warm-up of nearest-neighbor shards to avoid cold-start blocking
- A small LRU-style hotset plus KV of recent prefixes for fast short-circuit hits

Questions for you:
1) Can Redwood accept an S3 presigned-read flow where Pinecone provides a signed URL to the shard files?
2) Are there any constraints on how the KV/prefix cache can be primed from an external partner?

Happy to run a short engineering call to align on implementation.

Best,
Ethan
Pinecone — Partnerships

Subject: Re: S3-backed dense index prefetch—proof-of-concept proposal

Vanessa — quick notes from an infra/security perspective:
- Presigned S3 reads: OK for hosted flows if Pinecone provides object-level presigned GETs and NimbusData owns the bucket/KMS. We need an allowlist entry for the Pinecone egress IPs and short TTL presigns (recommended 5m).
- Pre-seed vs pull: the simplest integration is pull-based on demand (query triggers Pinecone to call our pre-seed API with a shard list). A push model is acceptable but requires signed webhook tokens + rate-limiting and an audit trail (we already have hooks for partner-driven seed).

I’ll create a short security checklist and share it by EOD. For the POC we should plan for the pull model to minimize surface area.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Manager, Deployments

Short engineering note — scope / questions for the sync:
- Pre-seed API: POST /v1/partners/prefetch with body {shard_ids, presigned_url, expected_ttl}. We should keep it idempotent and rate-limited.
- Disk & memory estimates: for Nimbus pilot (12B vectors, 2TB shard objects) expect ~80GB hotset + ephemeral shard staging. Need to confirm whether Pinecone will serve smaller chunked shards or full-file objects.
- Instrumentation: add metric partner.prefetch.latency and partner.prefetch.size_bytes.

Attaching a rough topology image. Will mark TODOs on MAP once we have the minutes.

Ben
